verdict.rationale: Google Cloud documents broad programmatic access. Cloud APIs are available via REST or client libraries to automate workflows, the gcloud CLI handles interactions with those APIs, billing and budgets can be managed through APIs, and infrastructure can be defined declaratively with Terraform via Infrastructure Manager. However, no evidence states that every console action has an API equivalent, so the 'everything' part of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: an explicit API/console parity statement or per-service coverage documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration that UI-only gaps do not exist.
